notes: Official TAV Esenboğa page https://esenbogaairport.com/en/facility-and-services/prayer-rooms. The site is a JavaScript app; its text was read on 18 Oct 2026 from the TAV content API that feeds it (cms.tav.aero, tenant "esb"). English: "In the Esenboga Airport there is a total of 12 prayer rooms which are always kept open for prayer. Domestic Terminal Arrival Floor, Behind the Lost Property Office on the Land Side : 2, At the end of the Domestic Terminal departure lobby: 2, At the end of the International Terminal departure lobby: 2, On the International Terminal air side mezzanine : 2, In the VIP building 2, In the CIP building : 2 ... for utilization of men and women." The Turkish version says 14: "Esenboğa Havalimanı’nda toplam 14 adet mescit bulunmakta olup, mescitler sürekli ibadete açık tutulmaktadır" (there are 14 mescits in total, always kept open for worship) and adds "İç Hatlar Hava Tarafı: 2" (domestic airside: 2); it ends "toplam 14 adet bay ve bayan mescit" (14 men's and women's mescits). The pages do not say whether the departure-lobby rooms are before or after security, and do not mention wudu areas. Feedback URL is the official Contact Us page. Not visually verified.

name: Konya Airport

spaces.name: Mescid (greeters' area)
spaces.location: Area for people meeting arriving passengers ("yolcu karşılayıcıları"), opened 2023
spaces.women: unknown

notes: Official DHMİ Konya Airport news item "Konya Havalimanı Yolcu Hizmetleri" (04.05.2023), https://www.dhmi.gov.tr/Sayfalar/Havalimani/Konya/HaberDetay.aspx?q=551, read directly 18 Oct 2026: "Konya Havalimanımızda yolcu karşılayıcılarının mağduriyetini çözmek için bay-bayan tuvalet, mescid, abdest alma, bölümü bay-bayan engelli tuvaleti ve çocuklarımız için oyun parkı hizmete girmiştir." (To solve the difficulties of people meeting passengers at Konya Airport, men's/women's toilets, a mescid, an ablution section, accessible toilets and a children's playground have been opened.) Side is recorded as landside because it serves greeters, who do not pass security. No mescit inside the terminal is described on the DHMİ Konya pages (İç/Dış Hat Terminali, Teknik Bilgiler ve Kolaylıklar); silence is not evidence of none. Feedback URL is the DHMİ Konya satisfaction survey page (DHMİ complaints also via https://alo.dhmi.gov.tr/). Not visually verified.
